Stranded in the Sirius Sector, the Detachments settled a number of worlds which they have adapted to their unique needs. The Detachments changed over time as well, becoming more distinct and developing their own ideas of how best to serve their Founder. Now, Detachments struggle to maintain a sense of unity and purpose as they become more distinct. Following the genetic innovations of the Founder, the Battle Brothers were soon deployed to maintain unity and peace over Earth and its nearby colonies. On a 6+ it is ignored. If the wounds were from a spell, then they are ignored on a 4+ instead. ### Special Rules Lacerate: When attacking the target must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6. Mend: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly model within 3" with Tough, and remove D3 wounds from it. Ravage(X): When it's this model's turn to attack in melee, roll X dice. For each 6+ the target takes one wound. Re-Deployment: After all other units are deployed (excluding units that were set aside), you may remove up to two friendly units from the table and deploy them again. Players alternate in placing Re-Deployment units, starting with the player that activates next. Re-Position Artillery: Once per activation, pick one friendly model within 6" with Artillery, which may immediately move by up to 9". Shielded: Units where all models have this rule get +1 to defense rolls against hits that are not from spells. Teleport: Once per activation, before attacking, you may place this model anywhere fully within 3" of its position when using Advance/Charge actions, or fully within 6" of its position when using Rush actions. Unstoppable Mark: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Unstoppable against once (next time the effect would apply). Versatile Attack: When this unit is activated, pick one effect: until the end of the activation, when shooting or charging enemies over 9" away, all models with this rule in this unit either get AP(+1) or get +1 to hit rolls. ### Aura Special Rules Bane in Melee Aura: This model and its unit get Bane in melee. Bane when Shooting Aura: This model and its unit get Bane when shooting. Courage Aura: This model and its unit get +1 to morale test rolls. Melee Shrouding Aura: This model and its unit get Melee Shrouding. Rapid Rush Aura: This model and its unit get Rapid Rush. Regeneration Aura: This model and its unit get Regeneration. Unpredictable Fighter Aura: This model and its unit get Unpredictable Fighter. Versatile Reach Aura: This model and its unit get Versatile Reach. Read more ### Spells Knight Sight (1): Pick one enemy unit within 18", which friendly units gets Unstoppable when shooting against once (next time the effect would apply). Knight Trauma (1): Pick one enemy unit within 18", which takes 1 hit with Blast(3) and Lacerate. Banishing Sigil (2): Pick up to two enemy units within 18", which get -1 to defense rolls once (next time the effect would apply). Doom Strike (2): Pick one enemy unit within 6", which takes 2 hits with AP(2) and Deadly(3). Knight Dome (3): Pick up to three friendly units within 12", which get Evasive once (next time the effect would apply). Purge the Impure (3): Pick up to two enemy units within 12", which take 3 hits with AP(2) each. ### Units ### Heroes Knight Master Destroyer [1] Qua 3+Def 3+ 150pts CCW(A4) Ambush, Fearless, Hero,
